name: Engineer
text: Gain a card costing up to $4.

name: Enhance
text: You may trash a non-Victory card from your hand, to gain a card costing up to $2 more than it.

name: Expedition
text: Draw 2 extra cards for your next hand.

name: Ferry
text: Move your -$0.)

name: Gamble
text: +1 Buy. Reveal the top card of your deck. It it's a Treasure or Action, you may play it. Otherwise, discard it.

name: Giant
text: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face down, +$6, and otherwise discards it and gains a Curse.

name: Guide
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this, to discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

name: Lost Arts
text: Move your +1 Action token to an ActionS upply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Action.)

name: March
text: Look through your discard pile. You may play an Action card from it.

name: Miser
text: Choose one: Put a Copper from your hand onto your Tavern mat; or +$1 per Copper on your Tavern mat.

name: Mission
text: Once per turn: If the previous turn wasn't yours, take another turn after this one, during which you can't buy cards.

name: Pathfinding
text: Move your +1 Card token to an ActionS upply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Card.)

name: Pilgrimage
text: Once per turn: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up); then if it's face up, choose up to 3 differently named cards you have in play and gain a copy of each.

name: Plan
text: Move your Trashing token to an ActionS upply pile. (When you buy a card from that pile, you may trash a card from your hand.)

name: Populate
text: Gain one card from each ActionS upply pile.

name: Pursue
text: +1 Buy. Name a card. Reveal the top 4 cards from your deck. Put the matches back and discard the rest.

name: Quest
text: You may discard an Attack, two Curses, or six cards. If you do, gain a Gold.

name: Raid
text: Gain a Silver per Silver you have in play. Each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Ranger
text: +1 Buy. Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face up, +5 Cards.

name: Ratcatcher
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this, to trash a card from your hand.

name: Reap
text: Gain a Gold. Set it aside. If you do, at the start of your next turn, play it.

name: Relic
text: +$2. When you play this, each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Ritual
text: Gain a Curse. If you do, trash a card from your hand. +1VP per $1 it cost.

name: Royal Blacksmith
text: +5 Cards. Reveal your hand; discard the Coppers.

name: Royal Carriage
text: +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. Directly after you finish playing an Action card, if it's still in play, you may call this, to replay that Action.

name: Save
text: Once per turn: +1 Buy. Set aside a card from your hand, and put it into your hand at end of turn (after drawing).

name: Scouting Party
text: +1 Buy. Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Discard 3 and put the rest back in any order.

name: Seaway
text: Gain an Action card costing up to $4. Move your +1 Buy token to its pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Buy.)

name: Summon
text: Gain an Action card costing up to $4. Set it aside. If you did, then at the start of your next turn, play it.

name: Toil
text: +1 Buy. You may play an Action card from your hand.

name: Trade
text: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Gain a Silver per card you trashed.

name: Training
text: Move your +$1.)

name: Transmogrify
text: +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this, to trash a card from your hand, and gain a card to your hand costing up to $1 more than it.

name: Transport
text: Choose one: Exile an Action card from the Supply; or put an Action card you have in Exile onto your deck.

name: Travelling Fair
text: +2 Buys. When you gain a card this turn, you may put it onto your deck.

name: Triumph
text: Gain an Estate. If you did, +1VP per card you've gained this turn.

name: Wedding
text: +1VP. Gain a Gold.

name: Windfall
text: If your deck and discard pile are empty, gain 3 Golds.

name: Wine Merchant
text: +$2. unspent, you may discard this from your Tavern mat.

name: Academy
text: When you gain an Action card, +1 Villager.

name: Aqueduct
text: When you gain a Treasure, move +1VP from its pile to this. When you gain a Victory card, take the VP from this. Setup: Put +8VP on the Silver and Gold piles.

name: Arena
text: At the start of your Buy phase, you may discard an Action card. If you do, take VP here per player.

name: Bandit Fort
text: When scoring, -2VP for each Silver and each Gold you have.

name: Bargain
text: Gain a non-Victory card costing up to $5. Each other player gains a Horse.

name: Barracks
text: At the start of your turn, +1 Action.

name: Basilica
text: When you buy a card, if you have +$2 or more left, take +2VP from here. Setup: Put +6VP here per player.

name: Baths
text: When you end your turn without having gained a card, take +2VP from here. Setup: Put +6VP here per player.

name: Battlefield
text: When you gain a Victory card, take 2VP from here. Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

name: Canal
text: During your turns, cards cost $0.

name: Citadel
text: The first time you play an Action card during each of your turns, play it again afterward.

name: City Gate
text: At the start of your turn, +1 Card, then put a card from your hand onto your deck.

name: Cobbler
text: At the start of your next turn, gain a card to your hand costing up to $4.

name: Colonnade
text: When you buy an Action card, if you have a copy of it in play, take +2VP from here. Setup: Put +6VP here per player.

name: Crop Rotation
text: At the start of your turn, you may discard a Victory card for +2 Cards.

name: Crypt
text: Set aside any number of Treasures you have in play, face down (under this). While any remain, at the start of each of your turns, put one of them into your hand.

name: Defiled Shrine
text: When you gain an Action, move +1VP from its pile to this. When you buy a Curse, take the VP from this. Setup: Put +2VP on each non-Gathering Action Supply pile.

name: Demand
text: Gain a Horse and a card costing up to $4, both onto your deck.

name: Ducat
text: +1 Coffers. +1 Buy. When you gain this, you may trash a Copper from your hand.

name: Exploration
text: At the end of your Buy phase, if you didn't buy any cards, +1 Coffers and +1 Villager.

name: Fair
text: At the start of your turn, +1 Buy.

name: Fleet
text: After the game ends, there's an extra round of turns just for players with this.

name: Fountain
text: When scoring, +15VP if you have at least 10 Coppers.

name: Ghost Town
text: At the start of your next turn, +1 Card and +1 Action. This is gained to your hand (instead of your discard pile).

name: Groom
text: Gain a card costing up to $4 If it's an...Action card, gain a Horse;Treasure card, gain a Silver;Victory card, +1 Card and +1 Action.

name: Guardian
text: Until your next turn, when another player plays an Attack card, it doesn't affect you. At the start of your next turn, +$1. This is gained to your hand (instead of your discard pile).

name: Guildhall
text: When you gain a Treasure, +1 Coffers.

name: Hostelry
text: +1 Card. +2 Actions When you gain this, you may discard any number of Treasures, revealed, to gain that many Horses.

name: Innovation
text: The first time you gain an Action card in each of your turns, you may set it aside. If you do, play it.

name: Keep
text: When scoring, +5VP per differently named Treasure you have, that you have more copies of than each other player, or tied for most.

name: Labyrinth
text: When you gain a 2nd card in one of your turns, take VP here per player.

name: Livery
text: +$4. or more, gain a Horse.

name: Monastery
text: For each card you've gained this turn, you may trash a card from your hand or a Copper you have in play.

name: Museum
text: When scoring, +2VP per differently named card you have.

name: Night Watchman
text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, discard any number, and put the rest back in any order. This is gained to your hand (instead of your discard pile).

name: Obelisk
text: When scoring, +2VP per card you have from the chosen pile. Setup: Choose a random Action Supply pile.

name: Orchard
text: When scoring, +4VP per differently named Action card you have 3 or more copies of.

name: Paddock
text: +$2. Gain 2 Horses.+1 Action per empty Supply pile.

name: Pageant
text: At the end of your Buy phase, you may pay $1 for +1 Coffers.

name: Palace
text: When scoring, +3VP per set you have of Copper - Silver - Gold.

name: Piazza
text: At the start of your turn, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an Action, play it.

name: Raider
text: Each other player with 5 or more cards in hand discards a copy of a card you have in play (or reveals they can't).At the start of your next turn, +$3.

name: Ride
text: Gain a Horse.

name: Road Network
text: When another player gains a Victory card, +1 Card.

name: Scrap
text: Trash a card from your hand. Choose a different thing per $1; gain a Silver; gain a Horse.

name: Sewers
text: When you trash a card other than with this, you may trash a card from your hand.

name: Silos
text: At the start of your turn, discard any number of Coppers, revealed, and draw that many cards.

name: Sinister Plot
text: At the start of your turn, add a token here, or remove your tokens here for +1 Card each.

name: Sleigh
text: Gain 2 Horses. When you gain a card, you may discard this, to put that card into your hand or onto your deck.

name: Stampede
text: If you have 5 or fewer cards in play, gain 5 Horses onto your deck.

name: Star Chart
text: When you shuffle, you may pick one of the cards to go on top.

name: Supplies
text: +$1. When you play this, gain a Horse onto your deck.

name: Tomb
text: When you trash a card, +1VP.

name: Tower
text: When scoring, +1VP per non-Victory card you have from an empty Supply pile.

name: Triumphal Arch
text: When scoring, +3VP per copy you have of the 2nd most common Action card among your cards (if it's a tie, count either).

name: Vagrant
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Curse, Ruins, Shelter, or Victory card, put it into your hand.

name: Wall
text: When scoring, -1VP per card you have after the first 15.

name: Wolf Den
text: When scoring, -3VP per card you have exactly one copy of.

name: Bandit Camp
text: +1 Card. +2 Actions Gain a Spoils from the Spoils pile.

name: Bard
text: +$2. Receive a Boon.

name: Blessed Village
text: +1 Card. +2 Actions When you gain this, take a Boon. Receive it now or at the start of your next turn.

name: Border Guard
text: +1 Action. Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and discard the other. If both were Actions, take the Lantern or Horn.

name: Catapult
text: +$3. or more, each other player gains a Curse. If it's a Treasure, each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand.

name: Cemetery
text: +2VP. When you gain this, trash up to 4 cards from your hand.Heirloom: Haunted Mirror

name: Cultist
text: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Ruins. You may play a Cultist from your hand. When you trash this, +3 Cards.

name: Cursed Village
text: +2 Actions. Draw until you have 6 cards in hand. When you gain this, receive a Hex.

name: Death Cart
text: You may trash this or an Action card from your hand, for +$5. When you gain this, gain 2 Ruins.

name: Encampment
text: +2 Cards. +2 Actions You may reveal a Gold or Plunder from your hand. If you do not, set this aside, and return it to the Supply at the start of Clean-up.

name: Exorcist
text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a cheaper Spirit from one of the Spirit piles.

name: Flag Bearer
text: +$2. When you gain or trash this, take the Flag.

name: Hermit
text: Look through your discard pile. You may trash a non-Treasure card from your discard pile or hand. Gain a card costing up to $3. When you discard this from play, if you didn't buy any cards this turn, trash this and gain a Madman from the Madman pile.

name: Idol
text: +$2. When you play this, if you then have an odd number of Idols in play, receive a Boon; if an even number, each other player gains a Curse.

name: Leprechaun
text: Gain a Gold. If you have exactly 7 cards in play, gain a Wish from its pile. Otherwise, receive a Hex.

name: Marauder
text: Gain a Spoils from the Spoils pile. Each other player gains a Ruins.

name: Page
text: +1 Card. +1 Action When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Treasure Hunter.

name: Patrician
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it costs $5 or more, put it into your hand.

name: Peasant
text: +1 Buy. +$1. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Soldier.

name: Pillage
text: Trash this. If you did, gain 2 Spoils, and each other player with 5 or more cards in hand reveals their hand and discards a card that you choose.

name: Pixie
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Discard the top Boon. You may trash this to receive that Boon twice. Heirloom: Goat

name: Pooka
text: You may trash a Treasure other than Cursed Gold from your hand, for +4 Cards.Heirloom: Cursed Gold

name: Sacred Grove
text: +1 Buy. +$3. Receive a Boon. If it doesn't give +$1, each other player may receive it.

name: Sauna
text: +1 Card. +1 Action. You may play an Avanto from your hand. While this is in play, when you play a Silver, you may trash a card from your hand.

name: Secret Cave
text: +1 Card. +1 Action You may discard 3 cards. If you did, then at the start of your next turn, +$3.Heirloom: Magic Lamp

name: Settlers
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Look through your discard pile. You may reveal a Copper from it and put it into your hand.

name: Shepherd
text: +1 Action. Discard any number of Victory cards, revealing them. +2 Cards per card discarded.Heirloom: Pasture

name: Skulk
text: +1 Buy. Each other player receives the next Hex. When you gain this, gain a Gold.

name: Swashbuckler
text: +3 Cards. If your discard pile has any cards in it: +1 Coffers, then if you have at least 4 Coffers tokens, take the Treasure Chest.

name: Tormentor
text: +$2. If you have no other cards in play, gain an Imp from its pile. Otherwise, each other player receives the next Hex.

name: Tracker
text: +$1. Receive a Boon. While this is in play, when you gain a card, you may put that card onto your deck.Heirloom: Pouch

name: Trader
text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a Silver per $1 it costs. When you gain a card, you may reveal this from your hand, to exchange the card for a Silver.

name: Treasurer
text: +$3. Choose one: Trash a Treasure from your hand; or gain a Treasure from the trash to your hand; or take the Key.

name: Urchin
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Each other player discards down to 4 cards in hand. When you play another Attack card with this in play, you may first trash this, to gain a Mercenary from the Mercenary pile.

name: Werewolf
text: If it's your Night phase, each other player receives the next Hex. Otherwise, +3 Cards.

name: Young Witch
text: +2 Cards. Discard 2 cards. Each other player may reveal a Bane card from their hand; if they don't, they gain a Curse. Setup: Add an extra Kingdom card pile costing $3 to the Supply. Cards from that pile are Bane cards.

name: Alchemist
text: +2 Cards. +1 Action. When you discard this from play, if you have a Potion in play, you may put this onto your deck.

name: Animal Fair
text: +$4. +1 Buy per empty supply pile. Instead of paying this card's cost, you may trash an Action card from your hand.

name: Apothecary
text: +1 Card. +1 Action. Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the Coppers and Potions into your hand. Put the rest back in any order.

name: Apprentice
text: +1 Action. Trash a card from your hand. +1 Card per P in its cost.

name: Black Market
text: +$2. Reveal the top 3 cards of the Black Market deck. Play any number of Treasures from your hand. You may buy one of the revealed cards. Put the rest on the bottom of the Black Market deck in any order. Setup: Make a Black Market deck out of different unused Kingdom cards.

name: Capitalism
text: During your turns, Actions with +$ amounts in their text are also Treasures.

name: Captain
text: Now and at the start of your next turn: Play a non-Duration non-Command Action card from the Supply costing up to $4, leaving it there.

name: Cathedral
text: At the start of your turn, trash a card from your hand.

name: Cavalry
text: Gain 2 Horses. When you gain this, +2 Cards, +1 Buy, and if it's your Buy phase return to your Action phase.

name: Changeling
text: Trash this. Gain a copy of a card you have in play. In games using this, when you gain a card costing $3 or more, you may exchange it for a Changeling.

name: Crown
text: If it's your Action phase, you may play an Action from your hand twice. If it's your Buy phase, you may play a Treasure from your hand twice.

name: Destrier
text: +2 Cards. +1 Action During your turn, this costs $1 less per card you've gained this turn.

name: Donate
text: After this turn, put all cards from your deck and discard pile into your hand, trash any number, shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 5 cards.

name: Druid
text: +1 Buy. Receive one of the set-aside Boons (leaving it there). Setup: Set aside the top 3 Boons face up.

name: Enchantress
text: Until your next turn, the first time each other player plays an Action card on their turn, they get +1 Card and +1 Action instead of following its instructions.At the start of your next turn, +2 Cards.

name: Familiar
text: +1 Card. +1 Action. Each other player gains a Curse.

name: Fisherman
text: +1 Card. +1 Action +$3 less.

name: Fool
text: If you aren't the player with Lost in the Woods, take it, take 3 Boons, and receive the Boons in any order.Heirloom: Lucky Coin

name: Gladiator
text: +$1. and trash a Gladiator from the Supply.

name: Golem
text: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal 2 Action cards other than Golems. Discard the other cards, then play the Action cards in either order.

name: Governor
text: +1 Action. Choose one; you get the version in parentheses: Each player gets +1 (+3) Cards; or each player gains a Silver (Gold); or each player may trash a card from their hand and gain a card costing exactly $2) more.

name: Grand Market
text: +1 Card. +1 Action. +1 Buy. +$2. You can't buy this if you have any Coppers in play.

name: Herald
text: +1 Card. +1 Action Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an Action, play it. When you buy this, you may overpay for it. For each $1 you overpaid, look through your discard pile and put a card from it onto your deck.

name: Inheritance
text: Once per game: Set aside a non-Command Action card from the Supply costing up to $4. Move your Estate token to it. (During your turns, Estates are also Actions with "Play the card with your Estate token, leaving it there.")

name: Invest
text: Exile an Action card from the Supply. While it's in Exile, when another player gains or Invests in a copy of it, +2 Cards.

name: Mountain Pass
text: When you are the first player to gain a Province, after that turn, each player bids once, up to +40DBT they bid.

name: Necromancer
text: Play a face up, non-Duration Action card from the trash, leaving it there and turning it face down for the turn. Setup: Put the 3 Zombies into the trash.

name: Overlord
text: Play a non-Command Action card from the Supply costing up to $5, leaving it there.

name: Peddler
text: +1 Card. +1 Action. +$1. During a player's Buy phase, this costs $2 less per Action card they have in play.

name: Possession
text: The player to your left takes an extra turn after this one, in which you can see all cards they can and make all decisions for them. Any cards or DBT they would gain on that turn, you gain instead; any cards of theirs that are trashed are set aside and put in their discard pile at end of turn.

name: Prince
text: You may set this aside. If you do, set aside an Action card from your hand costing up to $4. At the start of each of your turns, play that Action, setting it aside again when you discard it from play. (Stop playing it if you fail to set it aside on a turn you play it.)

name: Rebuild
text: +1 Action. Name a card. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Victory card you did not name. Discard the rest, trash the Victory card, and gain a Victory card costing up to $3 more than it.

name: Scrying Pool
text: +1 Action. Each player (including you) reveals the top card of their deck and either discards it or puts it back, your choice. Then reveal cards from your deck until revealing one that isn't an Action. Put all of those revealed cards into your hand.

name: Stonemason
text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain 2 cards each costing less than it. When you buy this, you may overpay for it. If you do, gain 2 Action cards each costing the amount you overpaid.

name: Storyteller
text: +1 Action. +$1 you paid.

name: Tax
text: Add 2DBT to a Supply pile. Setup: Add 1DBT to each Supply pile. When a player buys a card, they take the DBT from its pile.

name: Transmute
text: Trash a card from your hand. If it is an…Action card, gain a DuchyTreasure card, gain a TransmuteVictory card, gain a Gold

name: University
text: +2 Actions. You may gain an Action card costing up to $5.

name: Vampire
text: Each other player receives the next Hex.Gain a card costing up to $5 other than a Vampire. Exchange this for a Bat.

name: Villa
text: +2 Actions. +1 Buy +$1 When you gain this, put it into your hand, +1 Action, and if it's your Buy phase return to your Action phase.

name: Vineyard
text: Worth +1VP per 3 Action cards you have (round down).

name: Wayfarer
text: +3 Cards. You may gain a Silver. This has the same cost as the last other card gained this turn, if any.
